config.experiment: M1B.2 — late-stage action-size scaling diagnostics (hypothesis test: micro-correction regime)
config.diagnostic_only: M1A dynamics, adaptive boundary policy, stopping rules, q, alpha, controller and metric definitions unchanged. This round only measures per-round action sizes and tests the micro-correction hypothesis.
config.hypothesis_under_test: exact feedback enters a micro-correction regime where per-round action size becomes O(1/K), making the exact stopping time grow ~proportionally to K. Falsification attempts are required, not confirmation.
config.throw_distribution: q_near(x) = 2(1-x); Q_q(a) evaluated from the exact CDF

action_diagnostics.sweep_mass: total mass in the adaptive prefix before the update
action_diagnostics.net_export_mass: moved_mass * (1 - Q_q(a_t)) — exact mass leaving the prefix under the canonical update (identity verified in tests)

config.D_max_bands_note: bands: <0.005, 0.005-0.01, 0.01-0.02, 0.02-0.05, >0.05 (upper bound exclusive of 1.01 cap for the open top band)

headline.hypothesis_micro_correction: FALSIFIED for gross action size: moved/net-export/L1 medians are K-independent (CV<2%) during the late stage; the controller churns ~15% of the sand per round at every resolution until the exact stop
headline.stopping_mechanism: exact stop = rare one-sweep annihilation event (all positive prefixes cleared in a single sweep); F(a)<=0.5 necessary condition held 4/4
